title: Melting poster datamosh
technique: A deliberate video-compression glitch: a clean picture flashes, then its own motion drags blocks of the last frame around.
music: Each kick drum snaps the clean picture back, fully on strong kicks and in ragged patches on weak ones, while snares restore about a third of it and break the smear into bigger tiles. Louder passages smear faster, vocals add vertical streaks and a red and blue colour split, and a new section of the song prints the next picture as a ghost over the old one before it snaps in on the beat.
as_processor: Treats the picture it is given like compressed video: shows it clean on each kick drum, then drags blocks of the last frame along the picture's own motion until the next kick.

takes.name: Poster
takes.description: The original look: a bold wordmark, one lit 3D model turning on a disc and flat colour fields, shown clean on the kick and melting in between.
words: A KICK REDRAWS THE POSTER. THEN ITS OWN MOTION DRAGS IT APART.
words_with_input: A KICK SHOWS THE INPUT CLEAN. ITS OWN MOTION DRAGS IT APART.

takes.name: Aisle
takes.description: A sideways tracking shot with no text through rows of objects standing on carpet tiles under strip lights, where near ones smear faster than far ones.
words: THE CAMERA SLIDES PAST 162 PROPS. NEAR ONES SMEAR FASTER.
words_with_input: DATAMOSH OF ANOTHER SCENE, LEFT TO ROT
FEWER CLEAN FRAMES: 16 PX BLOCKS SLIDE ALONG THE INPUT'S MOTION.

takes.name: Transplant
takes.description: The clean frames are a big off-centre card of bold type, but the motion comes from a huge turning model that is never shown, so the lettering gets carved into the model's shape.
words: THE TYPE IS THE CLEAN FRAME. A HIDDEN 3D MODEL MOVES IT.
MOTION FROM A MODEL YOU NEVER SEE.
EACH KICK STAMPS THE MODEL IN.
A HARD KICK REDRAWS THE CARD.
words_with_input: THE INPUT IS THE CLEAN FRAME. A HIDDEN 3D MODEL MOVES IT.

takes.name: Macro
takes.description: A fast five-times zoom into the glitched picture with a grid of blocks and a motion arrow drawn on each one, turning letters and dots into huge torn shapes.
words: EACH SQUARE IS ONE BLOCK. ITS LINE IS THE MOTION IT COPIES.
words_with_input: DATAMOSH OF ANOTHER SCENE, ZOOMED IN

takes.name: One-bit
takes.description: Pure black and white: rows of phrases slide in opposite directions with a dithered model punched through, and new pictures arrive as a scan from the top.
words: PURE BLACK AND WHITE. KICKS REDRAW IT. MOTION SMEARS IT.
DATAMOSH IN PURE BLACK AND WHITE.
BETWEEN KICKS, OLD PIXELS ARE PUSHED.
THE KICK DRUM REDRAWS THE FRAME.
WEAK KICKS REDRAW ONLY THE TOP.
BLOCKS OF 16 PIXELS MOVE AS ONE.
EVERY PIXEL IS BLACK OR WHITE.
A NEW SHOT SCANS IN FROM THE TOP.
ONE SHADER FED ITS OWN LAST FRAME.
words_with_input: THE INPUT IS DITHERED TO BLACK AND WHITE, THEN SMEARED.

takes.name: Void
takes.description: A nearly black frame with a small object, a caption and five floating tubes in one hot colour, where every light thing grows into a rising column until a strong kick clears it.
words: BRIGHT PIXELS COPY UPWARD EACH FRAME. A HARD KICK CLEARS THEM.
EACH LIGHT GROWS A RISING COLUMN.
A HARD KICK WIPES THE COLUMNS.
words_with_input: THE INPUT'S BRIGHT PIXELS COPY UPWARD. A HARD KICK CLEARS THEM.

takes.name: Floor plan
takes.description: The same field of objects seen from straight above on checkered tiles, with a phrase painted across the floor and a camera that turns with the bar and drops in.
words: 162 PROPS ON TILES. THE CAMERA SWINGS IN TIME WITH THE MUSIC.
THE CAMERA TURNS WITH THE MUSIC.
words_with_input: A KICK SHOWS THE INPUT CLEAN. ITS OWN MOTION DRAGS IT APART.
